crossRefs.note: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their…
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”
At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted…

translations.web: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
translations.bsb: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
translations.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
translations.asv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
